主要内容: On February 21, 2013, KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. announced its quarterly cash dividend to shareholders. The dividend amount was set at 24 cents per share, representing an increase from the previous quarter's 23 cents per share. The dividend payment was scheduled to be made on March 29, 2013, to shareholders of record as of March 20, 2013. This announcement was included in a press release dated February 21, 2013, which was filed as Exhibit 99.1. The company's Chief Financial Officer, Gregory J. Dawson, signed the report on behalf of the registrant.
